provider_changelog.note: Version notes also revise earlier 2020-2022 GPS files; metadata count growth is not independent biological cohort size.

only_authorized_download: two pinned reference-data.csv files; downloading GPS/event observation members expressly forbidden

parsing_rules.independent_identity_key: animal-id (study-local animal identity, not tag ID, not deployment ID)
parsing_rules.duplicate_animal_id_records: collapse deployments, require consistent non-empty taxon per animal
parsing_rules.aliases: map old corrected ID to new ID only when the old identity is present in v3 and new identity present in v2026; flag mismatch otherwise
parsing_rules.old_removed: historical IDs absent from newer file may not be relabeled as new; retain counts as attrition
parsing_rules.unknown_or_changed_taxon: stop rather than treating identity as newly eligible

admission_rule.note: Necessary count for k=floor((9+1)*0.1)=1; it is not sufficient for biological independence, telemetry quality, covariate support, exchangeability, or external generality.

closure: Never compute altitude, speed, per-event covariates, GPS timestamps, held-out scores or RF outcomes during this gate.
